_comment: Mocked Lambda integrations for Step Functions Local (spec §6). Mocks the per-tier waitForTaskToken outcomes AND the commit tasks so the ASL routing (Choice on outcome, tier-to-tier, commit -> next) is exercised WITHOUT the lambda shim or a DB. Test cases are referenced as <stateMachineArn>#<TestCaseName>. The real end-to-end path (no #TestCase) invokes the shim instead.
